notes.title: Your Reviews Inspire Us! ✨
notes.content:
[p][b]Hi, you most dearest of followers! 🤗[/b]💛
[/p][p]Thank you so much for playing the demo and sharing tons of feedback with us.[/p][p]We’ve received more than 4,200 responses, and that’s huge! We’re truly grateful!  

[i]Just see how many of you like the game:[/i] 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/6681accca5b3914f578af003d2dbc053980a81eb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Reading your warm, supportive, and funny thoughts has been pure joy. Whenever I need to cheer myself up, I go back to the question, [i]“What do you like about Woodo?”[/i] and it honestly feels like therapy. 🤭[/p][p]
[b]We carefully read everything you wrote and already made a plan for future updates. ✍️[/b][/p][p]Over the past days, we released a few patches to fix the most obvious issues, and now we’re preparing bigger improvements based on your feedback.
[/p][p][b]Here are the main things we’re going to work on:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improving controls[/p][/*][*][p]Adding [b]Foxy’s diary[/b], where players (especially non-native English speakers) will be able to reread the narrator’s lines without worrying they missed something during gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Expanding localization into some more languages[/p][/*][*][p]We are also considering your other ideas and working on the rest of the game, of course! [/p][/*][/list][p]If you enjoy playing and want to support us, you can wishlist the game or leave a review on Steam - it has a huge effect! 😌[/p][p]
See you,[/p][p]💌 Your [b]Tiny Monks Tales[/b] team[/p]

notes.title: Our Woodo Demo is out now!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings everyone,[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]You can't believe how giddy we are - the little duckling in the picture already knows what's up: 

The [b]Woodo demo is out today[/b], and we're so excited to finally present (parts of) what we have been working on! ✨🥳 ✨  

Whether you're joining us out of curiosity or simply love cozy games, we're so glad to have you with us! We hope Woodo brings you a little comfort and joy. If our bite-sized, puzzle vacations make you smile or let you re-discover this special warm & fuzzy feeling deep inside, then we've done our job right. 💛🤗       
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/1494d0efa344ad709639f59f56dd1b323c7d7fb7.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p][i]A few things to know before you jump in:
[/i][/p][h3][b]Gamepad support is available![/b][/h3][list][*][p]You can play the demo with a controller. Just a heads-up: vibration feedback isn't polished yet, so it's turned off by default for now.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Steam Deck status: early support [/b][/h3][list][*][p]Woodo is playable on the Steam Deck, but touchscreen functionality hasn't been implemented yet. The game hasn't been tested or optimized specifically for Steam Deck, so your experience may vary.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]We'd love your feedback![/b][/h3][list][*][p]If you finished our demo, a short survey will pop up for you. It would help us, as a (very) small Developer Studio a lot, if you could fill it out for us. This way, we can guarantee that no detail of feedback gets lost - Every thought matters, because big things grow from small seeds!   

[/p][/*][/list][p]Want to celebrate with us? Come join our freshly created [url="https://discord.gg/DE2kkHsz2P"]Discord Server[/url]! 👋😚[/p][p][i]
The Woodo Team[/i]  [/p]

notes.title: Step into the World of Woodo on August 7!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We're thrilled to share some incredibly exciting news with you: after months (and for some, even years!) of anticipation, you can finally play the Woodo demo - the boss of cozy games! 🥳💃🕺[/p][p]Some of you have been waiting for this moment for years; thank you so much for sticking with us! And if you've just found us, welcome to the cozy corner of Woodo! It's your curiosity and warmth that make this whole journey feel so alive. 💛[/p][p]We can't wait to hear your feedback because it's incredibly important to us and will help shape Woodo into an even more wonderful experience for everyone. 
[/p][p]Let's enjoy it together, and see you in the game! 😃[/p][p]
The Woodo Team

notes.title: Meet the Voice of Foxy
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 🦊

Maybe you’ve seen our latest posts on social media, but in case you missed it: We introduced the narrator's voice of Foxy!! Because cozy wooden animals NEED a soothing voice to express themselves properly, right?

So, we’re thrilled to introduce you to [b]Miriam-Teak Lee[/b], the talented voice actress behind our protagonist Foxy! In the video below, you’ll find a heartwarming and cozy interview where she talks about her childhood, her experience as a voice actress and how she feels Woodo might resonate with players.

Enjoy the video! We hope you’ll be just as delighted as we are to meet Miriam-Teak Lee!

notes.title: Woodo Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
Hey there dear friends of coziness,

We want to share with you the process of making Woodo! 
This is why we decided to introduce you to our Woodo Dev Diary where we plan to give you an insight into the changes and improvements during development.

[h3]🎉 Finally, We Can Share the Map![/h3]

We’re excited to show you the level selection map for our game — it’s visually close to being finished! The map itself is rendered as a static image, but to achieve the right shadows, we built a simple 3D structure underneath it. Since we’re using an orthographic camera, the shadows align perfectly with the 3D objects, creating the illusion that they’re cast over a flat 2D surface. 🗺️✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/9c806b852d498967850cc42df5122a90a12b1966.png[/img]

[h3]🔍 How It Works in Unity[/h3]

Here’s a GIF showing how it looks in Unity. We opted for this approach to optimize performance — a fully 3D scene would be too heavy, and we wouldn’t be able to reach this level of quality. However, the characters on the map will still be in 3D, so we can animate them later on. It was quite a challenge to get the 3D shadows to blend naturally with a 2D image, but we’re happy with the result! 😅👌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/bf66bf7fc4b6f90730166108225e1558f75e6180.gif[/img]

[h3]🐸 Adding Some Life to the Map[/h3]

We haven’t implemented any animations yet, but we tested importing a few simple ones — like a frog 🐸 and a watermill 🌊 — to see how it would work. As you progress through the levels, the map will gradually fill with color 🎨, and the characters in that section will start animating. We hope this gives you an extra goal — a meta-objective — to complete every level and see the entire map come to life! ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/124d641362f95914a110fcec13ff892406cc457b.gif[/img]

[h3]🎮 Button Animations [/h3]

We’ve also been working on button animations:

🔓 Unlocking new levels
🎯 Selecting a level
🚪 Transitioning to a level
For the large "Play" button, we plan to show your progress with a subtle ring around it. 🔄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/bbb0156626764c93e26c8fd3c5e816a9f8da5a2a.gif[/img]

[h3]🛠️ From Concept to Reality[/h3]

And here’s a look at where it all started. It began as a simple blockout in Blender. I (because I handle the visuals 🎨) first sketched out the overall look, defined the main locations in the game, and then figured out how to reflect them on the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/a1b5c65d5c7e5eb3b2a3a4279d3b5ad56a15440c.png[/img]

We hope you enjoyed hearing more about our process! 
Let us know what you think! 🤗

There are exciting times ahead and we can't wait to share it with you!

Lots of cozy love,
Yullia Prohorova

notes.title: Cute - Cozy - Console!
notes.content:
Dear friends of wholesome games!

Long time no read!
We've been a little quieter on social media in recent weeks, but of course there were good reasons for that.
In the meantime, we, as a team of two, have been working non-stop on Woodo and we even have brought the demo to Gamescom, PAX West and Tokyo Game Show for you to play!

Today, we can proudly announce that [b]Woodo is also coming to consoles[/b]!
This way, Woodo becomes more available and we can bring the feeling of relaxing childhood memories to all of you!

Have a cozy day,

Yullia & Timur from Team Woodo
